description: Write back to Eyepup that you (or your coding agent) just shipped a change. The dossier agent reasons about every visitor profiled AFTER this log row, so it can grade whether the friction pattern recovered. CALL THIS after every UX edit, copy change, or pricing tweak — without the log, the agent has no idea what changed and the auto-loop stays open.

description.description: Longer notes the AI should weigh.

kind.description: What kind of change. Pick the most accurate — wrong kinds poison the dossier agent's reasoning. Default 'other'.

paths.description: Comma-separated paths affected, e.g. '/pricing,/checkout'. Helps the agent scope the impact analysis.

site.description: Apex domain — if you have multiple sites, scope the log.

title.description: One-line headline of what shipped (5-120 chars). Examples: 'Rewrote /pricing CTA', 'Replaced annual/monthly toggle with two cards'.

name: eyepup_log
title: Log a change you just shipped
